command:
cat <<'ANTRIEB_EOF' | sudo tee /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh > /dev/null
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
DATA_DIR="/var/lib/inventory"
LOG_FILE="$DATA_DIR/inventory.log"
COUNT_FILE="$DATA_DIR/counter"

[ -f "$COUNT_FILE" ] || echo 0 > "$COUNT_FILE"

while true; do
  n=$(cat "$COUNT_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  n=$((n + 1))
  echo "$n" > "$COUNT_FILE"
  printf '%s tick=%s\n' "$(date -Iseconds)" "$n" >> "$LOG_FILE"
  sleep 10
done
ANTRIEB_EOF
sudo chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh
cat /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh
